With every painter refusing the job and daily bamboo scaffolding rent piling up, society members put the blame squarely on Jethalal. Feeling guilty, Jethalal apologizes to everyone, but Bapuji reassures him that it wasn't his fault.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
